source_read: dunkin.co.uk/allergens-donuts, -munchkins, -cookies, -bakery, -lto-donuts, -hot-drinks, -cold-drinks (saved 2026-10-08, crawl delay 31 s; identical product text to the 2026-10-07 copies) and the 76 product pages saved 2026-10-07; nine product pages re-downloaded 2026-10-08 (toffee-apple, churro, speculoos-caramel-crumb-1, espresso, coffee-frappe, cappuccino, pumpkin-matcha-oat-latte-1, flat-white, maple-pecan-pie-latte-3) were unchanged. Rendered in Chromium (Playwright, JavaScript off, offline) and read from the page text with a second parser that shares no code with the extractor
notes: Every published item's row was compared with the rendered allergen page AND the rendered product page (97 of 97 published items: contains, may contain; a random 45 first, then all). A row is published only where both of the chain's pages print a list and the lists agree. Held back for allergens (35 items, listed with the reason in holdback.csv): Blackberry Lemonade, Blush Spritz, Starlight Lemonade, Atlantic Ice, Strawberry Lemonade (no allergen line on either page), Iced Green Tea and Shaken Iced Tea (empty line), Espresso (allergen page: Milk, product page: no allergen block), Toffee Apple, Churro and Speculoos Caramel Crumb (allergen page lists Nuts only under may contain, product page lists Nuts as contained: the chain contradicts itself), Maple Pecan Pie Latte and Churro Iced Matcha (name says pecan, pie, churro but both pages print milk only). Hazelnut Pie and Glazed Munchkins stay held back for their calories (2). Drinks print no may-contain line except two, so those rows list no traces. 'Dairy in Milk Choice' (allergen page) = Milk (product page) and 'Cereals' = Cereals (Gluten) were accepted only because the other page prints the standard word. Audit: 0 high, 0 medium (Toasted Marshmallow Iced Matcha logged as a flavour name in data/audit/reviewed/dunkin.csv).
